wintergrave.behindText: Kills raise a rimeling in place of a spirit: it flings icicles that chill, then freeze.
wintergrave.monsterText: Its blows slow you; when it dies, it rises as a rimeling that flings icicles at you for a few seconds.

stormwake.name: Stormwake
stormwake.about: Reaping and Lightning, melded. Every death a thunderclap.
stormwake.frontText: Arcs to nearby enemies; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and each soul looses a bolt at the nearest enemy.
stormwake.behindText: Kills raise a stormwisp in place of a spirit: it darts in and zaps, each zap jumping on to a second enemy.
stormwake.monsterText: Its blows shock you; when it dies, it rises as a stormwisp that darts at you and zaps you for a few seconds.

bogborn.name: Bogborn
bogborn.about: Reaping and Poison, melded. What rots, breeds.
bogborn.frontText: Poisons; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and an enemy that dies poisoned bursts, poisoning those near it.
bogborn.behindText: Kills raise a blight toad in place of a spirit: it hops after enemies and spits venom, and when its time is up it bursts in a cloud of poison.
bogborn.monsterText: Its blows poison you; when it dies, it rises as a blight toad that spits venom at you and bursts in a cloud of poison.

charnel.name: Charnel
charnel.about: Reaping and Power, melded. The dead, made strong.
charnel.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and each soul gathered adds to your damage for a few seconds.
charnel.behindText: Kills raise a bonebrute in place of a spirit: slow and huge, it slams the ground, striking everything near it and throwing it back.
charnel.monsterText: It hits harder and has more life; when it dies, it rises as a bonebrute that stomps after you and slams the ground.

impaler.name: Impaler
impaler.about: Piercing and Power, melded. Through them all, with force.
impaler.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying more force into each enemy it goes through.
impaler.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying more force.
impaler.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Hits harder and has more life.

stinger.name: Stinger
stinger.about: Piercing and Poison, melded. Through them all, with poison.
stinger.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying poison into each enemy it goes through.
stinger.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying poison.
stinger.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Poisons you.

icelance.name: Icelance
icelance.about: Piercing and Frost, melded. Through them all, with frost.
icelance.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying a chill that freezes on the second into each enemy it goes through.
icelance.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying a chill that freezes on the second.
icelance.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Deals frost damage and slows you.

sunspear.name: Sunspear
sunspear.about: Piercing and Flame, melded. Through them all, with fire.
sunspear.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying fire that sets them burning into each enemy it goes through.
sunspear.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying fire that sets them burning.
sunspear.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Deals fire damage and sets you burning.

stormlance.name: Stormlance
stormlance.about: Piercing and Lightning, melded. Through them all, with lightning.
stormlance.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying lightning that arcs on to the next enemy into each enemy it goes through.
stormlance.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying lightning that arcs on to the next enemy.
stormlance.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Deals lightning damage and shocks you.

dart.name: Dart
dart.about: Piercing and Swift, melded. Through them all, with speed.
dart.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, and each enemy it goes through gives you haste.
dart.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, and each enemy it strikes gives you haste.
dart.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Moves and attacks faster.

batteringram.name: Battering Ram
batteringram.about: Piercing and Heavy, melded. Through them all, with weight.
batteringram.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying a stun into each enemy it goes through.
batteringram.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying a stun.
batteringram.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Its blows knock you back.

pitchfork.name: Pitchfork
pitchfork.about: Piercing and Twin, melded. Through them all, with a second blow.
pitchfork.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying a second strike into each enemy it goes through.
pitchfork.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying a second strike.
pitchfork.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Attacks twice.

bloodlance.name: Bloodlance
bloodlance.about: Piercing and Leech, melded. Through them all, with a thirst.
bloodlance.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, and each enemy it goes through gives you life back.
bloodlance.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, and each enemy it strikes gives you life back.
bloodlance.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Heals when it hits you.

shrapnel.name: Shrapnel
shrapnel.about: Piercing and Volatile, melded. Through them all, with a blast.
shrapnel.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying a burst into each enemy it goes through.

finalhour.frontText: Enemies left nearly dead by its hit die outright, and the killing blow bursts out to those near, carrying a stillness that slows their attacks.
finalhour.behindText: Leaves a reaper's mark that culls the first weak enemy to cross it, and the cull bursts out to those near, carrying a stillness that slows their attacks.
finalhour.monsterText: Hits much harder when you are low. Its blows slow your cooldowns.

ricochet.behindText: Your dodge releases a surge, carrying a split to two more enemies.
ricochet.monsterText: Sends out a shockwave every few seconds. Splits in two when it dies.

hexwave.behindText: Your dodge releases a surge, carrying a curse.

tangle.behindText: Your dodge releases a surge, carrying a root that holds them.
tangle.monsterText: Sends out a shockwave every few seconds. Its blows root you to the spot.

harrow.name: Harrow
harrow.about: Piercing and Bleeding, melded. Through them all, with blood.
harrow.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying bleeding into each enemy it goes through; and makes enemies bleed, worse while they move; each fresh wound carries a strike through to the one behind.
harrow.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying bleeding; and leaves thorns that cut whatever walks through, carrying a strike through to the one behind.
harrow.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Its blows make you bleed.

wraithspear.name: Wraithspear
wraithspear.about: Piercing and Reaping, melded. Through them all, with the dead.
wraithspear.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit into each enemy it goes through; and kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns and flies at the nearest enemy, carrying a strike through to the one behind.
wraithspear.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit; and kills raise a spirit that fights for you; its blows carry a strike through to the one behind.
wraithspear.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Rises once after it dies.

deathblow.name: Deathblow
deathblow.about: Piercing and Culling, melded. Through them all, with the cull.
deathblow.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying a cull of the weak into each enemy it goes through; and enemies left nearly dead by its hit die outright, and the killing blow bursts out to those near, carrying a strike through to the one behind.
deathblow.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying a cull of the weak; and leaves a reaper's mark that culls the first weak enemy to cross it, and the cull bursts out to those near, carrying a strike through to the one behind.
deathblow.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Hits much harder when you are low.

breakthrough.name: Breakthrough
breakthrough.about: Piercing and Surging, melded. Through them all, with a surge.
breakthrough.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, carrying a shockwave into each enemy it goes through; and every third use releases a shockwave round you, carrying a strike through to the one behind.
breakthrough.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, carrying a shockwave; and your dodge releases a surge, carrying a strike through to the one behind.
breakthrough.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you. Sends out a shockwave every few seconds.

bloodharvest.behindText: Leaves thorns that cut whatever walks through, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit; and kills raise a spirit that fights for you; its blows carry bleeding.
bloodharvest.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed. Rises once after it dies.

butcher.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed. Hits much harder when you are low.

bloodwave.behindText: Leaves thorns that cut whatever walks through, carrying a shockwave; and your dodge releases a surge, carrying bleeding.
bloodwave.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed. Sends out a shockwave every few seconds.

harvest.about: Reaping and Culling, melded. The dead rise, with the cull.
harvest.frontText: Kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns and flies at the nearest enemy, carrying a cull of the weak; and enemies left nearly dead by its hit die outright, and the killing blow bursts out to those near, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit.
harvest.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that fights for you; its blows carry a cull of the weak; and leaves a reaper's mark that culls the first weak enemy to cross it, and the cull bursts out to those near, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit.
harvest.monsterText: Rises once after it dies. Hits much harder when you are low.

soulstorm.name: Soulstorm
soulstorm.about: Reaping and Surging, melded. The dead rise, with a surge.
soulstorm.frontText: Kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns and flies at the nearest enemy, carrying a shockwave; and every third use releases a shockwave round you, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit.
soulstorm.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that fights for you; its blows carry a shockwave; and your dodge releases a surge, carrying death's hold, so that any it kills rises as a spirit.
soulstorm.monsterText: Rises once after it dies. Sends out a shockwave every few seconds.

deathknell.name: Deathknell

deathknell.behindText: Leaves a reaper's mark that culls the first weak enemy to cross it, and the cull bursts out to those near, carrying a shockwave; and your dodge releases a surge, carrying a cull of the weak.
deathknell.monsterText: Hits much harder when you are low. Sends out a shockwave every few seconds.

twin2.name: Twin II
twin2.about: Two Twin, melded: Twin at level 2.
twin2.frontText: Strikes, fires or bursts three times, each a little weaker.
twin2.behindText: Repeats itself twice, each repeat weaker.

leech2.name: Leech II
leech2.about: Two Leech, melded: Leech at level 2.
leech2.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, half as much again.
leech2.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs more often.
leech2.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, half as much again.

volatile2.name: Volatile II
volatile2.about: Two Volatile, melded: Volatile at level 2.
volatile2.frontText: Enemies it kills explode, half as big and hard again.
volatile2.behindText: Leaves a rune that detonates half as big and hard again.
volatile2.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, half as hard again.

precise2.name: Precise II
precise2.about: Two Precise, melded: Precise at level 2.
precise2.frontText: More damage still, a smaller area still.
precise2.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next two hits on it are certain criticals.
precise2.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour, half as much again.

frenzied2.name: Frenzied II
frenzied2.about: Two Frenzied, melded: Frenzied at level 2.
frenzied2.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, each step half as big again, up to five times.
frenzied2.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, half as long again.
frenzied2.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, half as much again.

guarding2.name: Guarding II
guarding2.about: Two Guarding, melded: Guarding at level 2.
guarding2.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield, half as big again.
guarding2.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you take even less damage.
guarding2.monsterText: Carries a shield half as big again.

lasting2.name: Lasting II
lasting2.about: Two Lasting, melded: Lasting at level 2.
lasting2.frontText: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
lasting2.behindText: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
lasting2.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer still on you.

fleeting2.name: Fleeting II
fleeting2.about: Two Fleeting, melded: Fleeting at level 2.
fleeting2.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
fleeting2.behindText: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
fleeting2.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster still.

vast2.name: Vast II
vast2.about: Two Vast, melded: Vast at level 2.
vast2.frontText: An even bigger area, a little less damage.
vast2.behindText: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.

swift2.name: Swift II
swift2.about: Two Swift, melded: Swift at level 2.
swift2.frontText: Faster to use again, half as much again.
swift2.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, half as big again.
swift2.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster, half as much again.

heavy2.name: Heavy II
heavy2.about: Two Heavy, melded: Heavy at level 2.
heavy2.frontText: Slower, hits harder still, and stuns half as long again.
heavy2.behindText: Leaves wider cracked ground that staggers longer.
heavy2.monsterText: Its blows knock you back farther.

pulling2.name: Pulling II
pulling2.about: Two Pulling, melded: Pulling at level 2.
pulling2.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck, from half as far again.
pulling2.behindText: Leaves a vortex half as wide and strong again.
pulling2.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it, half as far again.

splitting2.name: Splitting II
splitting2.about: Two Splitting, melded: Splitting at level 2.
splitting2.frontText: Breaks into four copies instead of three, each a little stronger.
splitting2.behindText: Half as many shards again, flying farther.
splitting2.monsterText: Splits in three when it dies.

hexing2.name: Hexing II
hexing2.about: Two Hexing, melded: Hexing at level 2.
hexing2.frontText: Its curse is half as strong again.
hexing2.behindText: Its hex circle is half as wide and strong again.
hexing2.monsterText: Its curse on you is half as strong again.

stilling2.name: Stilling II
stilling2.about: Two Stilling, melded: Stilling at level 2.
stilling2.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time half as much again.
stilling2.behindText: Its bubble is half as wide again and lasts half as long again.
stilling2.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns half as much again.

binding2.name: Binding II
binding2.about: Two Binding, melded: Binding at level 2.
binding2.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits half as long again.
binding2.behindText: Its snare catches the next two enemies to cross it.
binding2.monsterText: Its blows root you half as long again.

piercing2.name: Piercing II
piercing2.about: Two Piercing, melded: Piercing at level 2.
piercing2.frontText: Goes through everything in its path, farther, and strikes what it goes through harder.
piercing2.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later, wider and harder.
piercing2.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you, and strike harder.

bleeding2.name: Bleeding II
bleeding2.about: Two Bleeding, melded: Bleeding at level 2.
bleeding2.frontText: Makes enemies bleed half as hard again, worse while they move.
bleeding2.behindText: Leaves wider thorns that cut half as hard again.
bleeding2.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed, half as hard again.

reaping2.name: Reaping II
reaping2.about: Two Reaping, melded: Reaping at level 2.
reaping2.frontText: Kills leave a soul that takes more time off your cooldowns.
reaping2.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that fights harder.
reaping2.monsterText: Rises once after it dies, with more of its life.

culling2.name: Culling II
culling2.about: Two Culling, melded: Culling at level 2.
culling2.frontText: Enemies left low by its hit die outright, from higher.
culling2.behindText: Leaves a reaper's mark that culls from higher.
culling2.monsterText: Hits much harder still when you are low.

surging2.name: Surging II
surging2.about: Two Surging, melded: Surging at level 2.
surging2.frontText: Every third use releases a greater shockwave round you.
surging2.behindText: Your dodge releases a greater surge.
surging2.monsterText: Sends out a greater shockwave every few seconds.
